title: Uruguayan Italian Bean Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew that combines the best of Italian and Uruguayan cuisines, featuring tender beans and a rich garlicky sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the crushed empanadas and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the yummy garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the can of uruguayan bean, tomato sauce, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
